findings: (a) HDMI/app-only user can see: input banner (launching on every input switch, OK banner, detail banner), No Signal screen + art photos, set-top alert (only if input set up as set-top), Universal Control alert (system alert), nu_input_game nudge, local-key OSD after button power-on, power-on reminder alert, 'This function is not available.' toast, update-progress badge, banner-position editor. When a streaming app is foreground inputcommon draws nothing. Live-TV-only: channel/zapping/detail banners, similar list, EAS (US), DVR, LivePick strip, Guide button, voice zapping, LG Channels splash/activation; DVB/JP/IDN/GBR/ITA/IND/BR families are also country-gated and unreachable (country USA, ATSC).

(b) Switches: general.noSignalScreenSaver (off = black gif box, no photo), general.noSignalGuideArea (Red key toggles text box), time.autoOff15Min=on here (TV powers off after 860 s no signal, silent; JP uses noSignalAutoOff), option.bannerPosition (none=lower-left), option.audioGuidance (timers 5->10 s), other.simplinkEnable=on, other.isSLZoomOn=off, option.storeMode=home, hotelMode flags (osdLock hides banners/screensaver), config tv.rmm.dvrReady=false (kills whole DVR family), supportClockDisplay=false (clock), profile.list lacks monitor/dpms/tunerless/touch (kills GameOption FPS/crosshair, DPMS popup), supportLivepick=true but service com.webos.service.livepick absent.

(c) Strings: header 'No Signal'; HDMI body (2 lines): '(1) Please check the power of the external devices and cable connection status.' + '(2) Press the [Home Hub][INPUT] button on the TV remote to change the input.' (glyphs U+100136, U+100105); HDMI ARC port and soundOutput != external_arc adds "(3) For external audio devices, please go to 'Settings > Sound > Sound Out' and change settings to 'HDMI ARC'."; single-HDMI/NMRM: 'Please check the power of the external devices and cable connection status.' Text-only variant (static screensaver countries, TV only): header 'No signal.', body 'Currently scanning for signals or no signal has been found.' + guide. Others: 'Invalid Format', 'Input Locked', 'Not Supported Service', '8K channel is not supported.', 'Press OK button for unlocking the screen.'; key help 'Show/Hide'. There is NO 'No Input' or 'Check connected device' string; unused alert strings 'No signal is detected. Do you want to check your input connections now?' and 'Please make sure the device is properly connected to the input.'. Power: 'The display will switch to standby mode in a few seconds.' (DPMS, unreachable); no sleep-timer UI here; no-signal power-off draws nothing.

(d) Drawing: native app, appinfo transparent:true, type card (no defaultWindowType), window group owner per input (layer1 z1, subtitle/teletext layers z<0); video is a separate pipeline under it; QML root 1920x1080 scaled by viewRatio. Stack top->bottom: popups, banners, fg (spinner, SLZoom own WebOSWindow), bg (screensaver, game, clock), key layer. Covered by anything above card: Home, livemenu (overlay), system UI, toasts/alerts (drawn by com.webos.notification, not inputcommon). setExportedWindow shrinks video for overlay apps/shopping.

Interfaces -> surface: Banner -> banner state machine/timers (5 s, 10 s audio guide, detail 30 s, livepick 7 s); InputBanner -> input banner/OK/detail rows; ChannelBanner -> channel banner/detail rows; MiniBanner -> mini banner (JP); LivePick -> LivePick strip; SimilarList -> SimilarListView; Screensaver -> No Signal screen, photo, mover, set-top alert, PIN prompt, auto-off; Nop -> auto-off timers 860 s / DPMS 555 s; HotelMode -> no UI, locks keys/banners; StoreDemo -> store alerts/overlay; SeniorTv -> recovery toast.

Interfaces -> surface (cont): Dvr -> DVR bar/info/popups/CI PIN/loading; Ci -> CiPopup; Teletext -> TeletextOptionView/toast; Ews -> EwsView (IDN); EwsUs -> EwsUsView; LcnConflictGbr/Ita -> LCN popups; LgChannel -> LgChannelSplash, LgChannelActivation, network alert; MusicCatch -> MusicCatchPopupView; Voice -> VoiceChannelZapping; SLZoom -> SLZoomView + SLZoomSelectArea; HybridTv -> LoadingView, GingaAppCatalog, HbbTV (off); JpMessage -> CaMessageView, EmmMessageView; GameOption -> GameOptionView; OverlayShopping -> shopping overlay app; Nudge -> nudge requests; ExternalDeviceControl -> input name/label, ICS alert, key forwarding; Popup/Event/Common/ChannelStatus -> AlertPopupView, notification alerts/toasts, launchApp, powerOff.

Interfaces -> no surface: Display (video pipeline, setExportedWindow, emits showLaunchingBanner on input start, AppViewEffect), ChannelChange, ChannelInfo, InAppSetting, SystemInfo, TvConfiguration (motor-moving screensaver text), AudioGuidance (TTS only), Cursor (pointer hide, MRCU activate), WindowGroup (iwc publish, ad overlay, screensaver voting), OpApp, CommonOpApp (operator apps; profile A disables most interfaces).

Keys on HDMI: first CommonInputEventHandler (GUIDE/ChannelDash/LiveTVMenu/ProgramList -> launch com.webos.app.livemenu; Text key -> toast), then ExternalInputEventHandler forwards to the device via IR (urcuEnable) or CEC mask (simplink, uniqueId 1..15); a forwarded OK is consumed and the OK banner is not shown. Else OK release -> OK banner, INFO -> detail banner, Back hides banner, EXIT (launchedByExitKey) -> launchDefaultAppWithHome. Pointer on top 10 px for 1 s -> OK banner.

Launch params accepted by inputcommon (replacement-relevant): showBanner, showBannerWithEdit, toggleInfo/infoStart, sendKeyPress/Release, switchOnOffClock, slZoom, uniqueId (CEC), channelChange, launchApp, storeDemoLaunch, debug screensaverType, testEws/testEwsUs/testCaMsg etc. DeepLinkHandler.launchParamHandler is the entry; test params can force screensaver states.

System-power coupling: WindowGroupInterfaces joins tvpower power2 registerScreenSaverRequest voting (ack true when multiview/hybrid/dmost/dvr/PC needs app screensaver) and calls turnOnScreen; on external inputs oledepl getPcScreenSaverResponse. powerOff reasons nosignal/dpms call tvpower power2/powerOff. EAS-ID (Indonesia) uses surfacemanager.input blockKeyInput and systemui closeAllSystemUI.

No-signal pipeline: utp.extinputs getSignalState(pipelineId) -> screensaverType -> Screensaver state FULLSS for every external input (viewType forced withImage); isVideoValid requires DisplayInterfaces delayedIsAvPlaying. Photo list = oledList 16 modernart_*.jpg plus images under igallery download folders (AIArt, digitalcanvas, mood_*), file existence checked on TV. LivePick/Game/Clock/Shopping are all inert on this set.

Cannot-trigger-here summary: DVR family, CI, Teletext, EWS (IDN and US-on-HDMI), LCN GBR/ITA, MusicCatch, Ginga, EMM/CA, DPMS, GameOption overlay, clock, LivePick, shopping, store demo, mini banners, hotel mode, operator-app mode. Verified via config/settings reads on the TV (country USA, ATSC, dvrReady false, profile.list without monitor/dpms) and absent services (livepick, shopping).
